extended.scope: Chromium emulation. Individual UI values, sequential interactions and 420 low-resolution non-shadow size/color/pose/view renders; deterministic still captures; ranges via keyboard; UI canvas DPR .55; not exhaustive appearance combinations or visual approval.

coverage.discrete_controls: all present values in each implemented button group
coverage.cross_product: 7 size labels x 3 colors x 5 poses x 4 views; completed count recorded below

pixel_validation.note: Nonuniform pixels are not visual approval; inspect actual screenshots.

glb_geometry_roundtrip.appearance: Actual front/side/back/detail reload renders archived; visual approval remains separate.

footwear_visual_effect.coverage: direct actual-render comparison of both footwear values in front and side views

appearance_pairwise.coverage: all value pairs across the seven listed factors, not the full Cartesian product

mobile_interaction.evidence: software-rendered Chromium with CDP touch emulation; owner physical-iPhone screenshots remain separate evidence

footwear_occlusion.coverage: exhaustive 2 footwear choices x 5 poses x 4 camera directions; 20 closed-shoe checks plus 20 barefoot negative controls
footwear_occlusion.pixel_threshold_rgb: R>160, B>160, G<80 for unlit magenta diagnostic mesh
footwear_occlusion.limits: Actual depth-tested forefoot visibility only, not every shoe boundary, physical fit or real-device validation

footwear_closeups.coverage: exhaustive 2 footwear choices x 5 existing poses x 4 close-up camera directions
footwear_closeups.limits: Image/state checks detect missing effects; actual visual inspection remains required.
